E0995

`workspace.jet` has no `module workspace { … }` declaration.

What

`workspace.jet` has no `module workspace { … }` declaration.

Why

`workspace.jet` is the monorepo index (D-WORKSPACE2=A); it must contain exactly one `module workspace { members: … }` body.

Fix

Write `module workspace { members: find("./packages") }` (or an explicit list) in `workspace.jet`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0995: tests/ui/workspace_e0995.stderr.
